ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Preventive Visit — Robert Peary — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Admiral Peary is a 62-year-old retired naval officer with pernicious anemia, now with normal blood counts on weekly cyanocobalamin injections, recovering subacute combined degeneration, autoimmune atrophic gastritis, iron deficiency on oral iron, and old frostbite amputations of the toes, who comes for his preventive visit two weeks after his eight-week review. His energy is much better and he walks a mile with his stick. The numbness in his feet has eased but not gone. The blister on his left forefoot has healed. He takes the iron every other day without stomach upset. He has never had shingles or pneumococcal vaccines, and his last tetanus booster was six years ago. He received influenza and COVID-19 vaccines in the autumn. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent. He named a health care agent and a health care proxy form was completed; the agent is recorded in the chart and is not named here. He said that what matters most to him is staying independent, walking, and being able to write. He chose not to record specific treatment preferences today. The plan will be revisited yearly or after any serious illness. [S]
